title: Can I BEAT the 12 Pawns Opening?
summary: Rosen Score challenge: win a rated game (~1600) after making 12 consecutive pawn moves from the start ("12 Pawns" trophy). Game 1 (White): twelve pawn moves done, won when the opponent abandoned; game 2 broken by a capture with check; game 3 an honest win without the twelve.
rules: Challenge: your first 12 moves must all be pawn moves (0:05, 1:48), then win the game for the trophy.
If a check forces a non-pawn move, the challenge fails for that game (5:28).
win_condition: Make 12 consecutive opening pawn moves, then win.
evidence: frame line (low): normal game + Rosen Score sheet; 12-pawn wall only in thumbnail. | cm-recheck2 2026-11-25: transcript (analyze_video) 0:01-0:16 rule, 1:48 twelve done, 3:56-4:22 win by abandonment + trophy, 5:28 failed attempt, 12:42 later win; mode file (g6_rosen pawns:12) matches.
